lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: Approximately 9 distinct vertical white lines are visible on the torso. The spacing is roughly equidistant in the anterior and mid-sections, with a noticeable decrease in inter-line distance toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped bifurcation is visible on the 8th line segment (counting from anterior) in the upper quadrant of the torso where a secondary branch merges into the primary vertical line.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The 7th vertical line is truncated, terminating in the mid-torso region. The 9th line is fragmented into two distinct segments separated by dark pelage.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: Two high-contrast white spots are visible on the lower haunch; one larger primary circular spot located centrally on the hindquarter and one smaller satellite spot located ventro-posteriorly to it.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: The horns exhibit a lyrate trajectory, diverging laterally at approximately 40 degrees from the skull base before curving medially and posteriorly toward the tips.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: The estimated ratio of the distance between the apical tips to the width of the horn bases is 2.2:1.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.terminal_contrast_ratio: Bright ivory tipping is visible, occupying approximately the terminal 12% of the total horn length.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of a prominent white chevron mark between the eyes, two white circular spots on the cheek/malar region, and a distinct white dorsal fringe extending from the neck to the tail.
